answer: Delay-Echo Admission Gating. Each new identity must emit its first N actions with randomized, Poisson-distributed inter-arrival times drawn from a shape it cannot renegotiate; late replays leave a canyon between claimed and observed timestamps. Admission requires the arrival trace to echo its declared schedule within tolerance. A sybil farm must either pay real wall-clock delay per identity, serializing registrations, or spoof timestamps that later fail cross-node lag checks across the lagoon of peers. Cost: attacker pays N times the delay plus detection risk per sock puppet.
